messages:
anna (AE): Hey team — VeloxMed sent an RFI asking for an embeddings capability matrix, throughput for 768/2048 dims, telemetry retention policy, private deploy options (VPC + airgap), HSM/BYOK, and a 3-week POC runbook. PDF uploaded to thread attachments.

kevin (SE): Can we confirm target QPS and average payload size? Bench numbers vary a lot by batch and concurrency.

anna (AE): They specified two flows: "search" ~400 sustained qps, spikes 1.2k (768-d), and "patient-sim" ~60 sustained qps with bursts to 300 (2048-d). Avg payload ~900 bytes.

lina (CS): I recommended a 3-week POC: week0 network + SSO, week1 baseline perf, week2 workload fidelity + telemetry validation. I can own the runbook.

omar (Infra Eng): Lab bench (A100 equiv): 768-d @ batch=128 -> ~580-640 qps/GPU median. 2048-d @ batch=32 -> ~240-280 qps/GPU. Results assume mixed-precision quant path and 1KB payload. No KV-cache for one-shot embeds.

omar (Infra Eng): Private connectivity supported: VPC peering, AWS PrivateLink, Azure Private Endpoint, and a physical gateway for on-prem/airgap installs. Need their CIDR blocks + firewall egress rules to size LB/NAT.

rex (Product): Capability matrix columns: feature, supported (Y/N), hosted note, dedicated note, private note, perf per GPU (768/2048), p50/p95/p99 latencies, telemetry defaults. I'll draft and include a short caveats column.

kevin (SE): Repro command I'll include with artifacts:
```
./embed-bench --model rwd-embed --dim 768 --batch 128 --concurrency 12 --out csv
```
Uploading CSV and a tiny README.

tess (Finance): Provisional pricing: Hosted 768-d = $0.00042/embed, Hosted 2048-d = $0.0019/embed. Dedicated entry (4-GPU pool) = $11,500/mo commit + $0.00008/embed over commit. POC discount: 50% off infra for first 30 days. Finance to confirm.

devploy-bot: deploy scheduled: sales/attachments/veloxmed_rfi_artifacts.tar.gz uploaded by kevin at 3111112250.

mira (Legal): HSM/BYOK: we support customer-managed keys via cloud KMS; HSM-backed storage available for Dedicated/Private via partner integration. On-prem HSM requires addendum and inventory of crypto ops. I'll attach clause snippets and SOC2 excerpt.

lina (CS): POC runbook draft uploaded. Included checklist: peering CIDRs, SSO metadata (SAML), test dataset sanitization script, and acceptance criteria: perf within 15% of bench and telemetry scrub validated.

omar (Infra Eng): Telemetry details: Hosted default retains request metadata (timestamps, model id, token counts, error codes) 45 days. Raw prompt bodies are not stored by default; debug capture is explicit opt-in and auto-purges after 7 days. Dedicated/Private: retention configurable and purge API available; can be set to 0 days.

kevin (SE): I'll draft the embeddings performance rows and attach latency plots (p50/p95/p99). Also note quantized model variants may reduce cost but increase p95 slightly; will include recommended defaults.

rex (Product): I'll assemble the CSV capability matrix and a one-page Hosted vs Dedicated economics slide. Will note operational differences: telemetry defaults, rollouts, SLAs.

mira (Legal): Uploaded HSM addendum draft and a GDPR/DSAR paragraph. Request VeloxMed legal contact and SSO Admin contact to finish the addendum.

tess (Finance): I'll double-check region multipliers; Dedicated commits differ by cloud region. Will confirm by EOD.

anna (AE): Action items: kevin -> perf artifacts; rex -> matrix + slide; lina -> finalize runbook; omar -> network diagram + sizing; mira -> legal attachments; tess -> confirm pricing. ETA first draft of RFI package: tomorrow EOD. Flag blockers now.

kevin (SE): Perf CSV + README uploaded to sales/attachments. README includes exact bench flags and env vars used.

omar (Infra Eng): Network diagram and sizing workbook uploaded. Note: if they want sub-100ms p99 globally we'll need multi-region routing and discuss additional costs.

rex (Product): Matrix uploaded (csv). I added a "notes" row about model fallbacks and graceful degradation (auto route to cheaper variant under load).

mira (Legal): I'll review assembled package before it's sent. Recommend adding a one-sentence contact for data subject requests and a short bullet on audit logs retention for compliance.

anna (AE): Thanks all. I'll collate and send to VeloxMed once legal & finance sign off. If anything blocks the send, call it out here.
